proof_scope.3613: Defines the main molecule and formal continued-fraction compactification, and records Conjectures 3.5-3.6 as open. Does not derive hyperbolicity from a topological model.
proof_scope.3614: Defines nice puzzle pieces and returns under critical recurrence; explains the one critical branch and univalent other branches using the puzzle pullback structure. The puzzle construction remains standard cited theory.

proof_scope.3616: Defines width as inverse connected exterior modulus and proves the reciprocal degeneration criterion. Horizontal/vertical thick-thin decomposition remains cited and is not asserted additive for arbitrary families.

proof_scope.3618: Fully derives the serial-width numerical implication and contradiction between persistent faster-than-exponential growth and an exponential upper bound. Wave Lemma, layer selection and conversion to QL moduli remain external.
proof_scope.3619: States the official pseudo-Siegel theorem at its stated construction scope and the precise bounded-type uniform outer-quasidisk theorem. Does not promote deep renormalized geometry to a uniform original-plane bound for every layer.

proof_scope.360B: Defines DH quadratic-like renormalization with degree-two restriction, connected little K and disjoint/satellite intersection condition. Defines affine normalization and distinguishes parameter-orbit rescaling.
proof_scope.360C: Defines primitive and satellite types through the orbit of a distinctly named base little filled Julia set. Satellite bouquets can be permuted along a cycle rather than sharing one contact point globally. Parameter interpretation is cited.
proof_scope.360D: Defines bounded relative periods and proves total-period product growth. Allows mixed primitive/satellite sequences; distinguishes rotation arithmetic.
proof_scope.360E: Defines annulus modulus through cited uniformization. Calculates logarithmic-cylinder model, similarity invariance and degree-d covering factor.
proof_scope.360F: Defines general curve-family extremal length/width; proves conformal invariance and the exact rectangular and annular crossing values by Cauchy-Schwarz.
proof_scope.360G: Gives the density proof of the serial Grötzsch inequality and its reciprocal-width formulation.
proof_scope.360H: Defines a priori and beau bounds with B, initial-modulus lower bound, entry time and tail bound in the correct quantifier order. Normalized-germ compactness is cited; mod and mod+ are not identified.
proof_scope.360I: Fully proves compact restriction H-infinity(U) to H-infinity(U') using Cauchy estimates, finite nets, diagonal subsequences and holomorphic limits.
proof_scope.360J: Cites complex-codimension-one analytic hybrid leaves and the local analytic equation for the fixed base map's leaf. Does not assert an analytic simultaneous transverse classification of all leaves.
